def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Fix sex label variant: FEMALE -> female
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].str.strip().str.lower()
    # Fix flipper_length_mm negatives (sign error)
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = df['flipper_length_mm'].abs()
    # Fix body_mass_g out-of-range values (likely entered in mg instead of g)
    mask = df['body_mass_g'] > 6500
    df.loc[mask, 'body_mass_g'] = df.loc[mask, 'body_mass_g'] / 1000
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    result = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return {k: float(v) for k, v in result.items()}
